LVYRON · INFORMATION

Policies & Terms

Please read our policies before placing an order. These policies are designed for LVYRON's current direct-to-customer and WhatsApp order flow.

01

Privacy Policy

LVYRON respects your privacy. When you place an order or contact us, we may collect information such as your name, phone number, email address, delivery address and order details.

This information is used to process orders, arrange delivery, provide customer support and communicate about your order. We do not intentionally sell your personal information to third parties.

Payment details, when handled through a future payment provider, may be processed directly by that provider under its own privacy and security policies.

02

Shipping Policy

Orders are processed after order confirmation and payment, where applicable. Delivery timelines may vary depending on destination, product availability and courier service.

Customers are responsible for providing a complete and accurate delivery address and reachable phone number. LVYRON is not responsible for delays caused by incorrect address details, failed delivery attempts, weather, courier issues or circumstances beyond reasonable control.

Any applicable shipping charges will be communicated before the order is finalized.

03

Exchange Policy

LVYRON offers exchanges for eligible products subject to availability. Exchange requests should be raised within 7 days of delivery.

Items must be unworn, unwashed, unused, undamaged and returned with original tags and packaging. Products showing signs of use, washing, alteration, damage or missing tags may not be eligible for exchange.

Exchange is subject to product and size availability. If the requested replacement is unavailable, LVYRON may offer an alternative solution at its discretion.

For an exchange request, contact LVYRON through the official WhatsApp/order contact and provide your order number, product details and reason for exchange.

Sale, customized or specially made items may be non-exchangeable unless LVYRON confirms otherwise.

04

Terms & Conditions

By placing an order with LVYRON, you confirm that the information provided by you is accurate and that you agree to these terms.

Product images are intended to represent the products as accurately as reasonably possible. Minor differences in colour, texture or appearance may occur due to lighting, screens and manufacturing characteristics.

Orders are subject to product availability and confirmation. LVYRON may contact the customer to verify order or delivery details before dispatch.

Prices, product availability, designs and policies may be updated from time to time. The policy applicable at the time an order is confirmed will generally apply to that order.

Nothing in these terms limits rights that cannot legally be excluded under applicable Indian law.

Need help? Contact LVYRON through the WhatsApp order channel with your order number and we’ll assist you.
